correctness.rationale: Explicit conditional coupling: the orbit fixes exactly T outputs, at most one image receives multiplicity 2; remaining outputs iid. Coupling with free occupancy and then with T independent additions yields the TV estimate for every history. Exact birthday distribution gives E[T] bound and Rayleigh/uniform repeat-index limit. Uniform binomial-to-Poisson rare-tail ratios and dominated multinomial factorial moments give the Poisson extreme count; finite exact-rational tests cover 50,068 maps and 802 assertions, without replacing infinite proof.

value.rationale: The new finite-n quenched product total-variation estimate addresses whether exposing an entire stopped orbit affects the globally rare high-indegree vertices, connecting sqrt(n)-scale exploration with log n/loglog n-scale extreme occupancy. Its joint rare-event and continuous orbit-tail/cycle limit does not follow from separate well-known marginals, and the independent full-history statement gives additional information beyond a scalar limit.
